name: File Weaver Community Library
description: Official presets and rules for File Weaver, maintained by Sprocket Consulting.

entries.name: Photo Cleanup
entries.description: Normalises camera filenames: strips IMG_ prefixes, reformats compact dates to YYYY-MM-DD, lowercases, trims spaces.

entries.name: Podcast Episodes
entries.description: Numbers files sequentially as a prefix (001-, 002-, ...) and lowercases the name for consistent episode filenames.

entries.name: TV Episode Tidy
entries.description: Normalises TV episode filenames: consistent s01e02 markers, drops the episode title, and cleans up leftover dashes.

entries.name: Truncate Long Names
entries.description: Script rule that shortens names longer than 40 characters and trims whitespace.

entries.name: Underscores to Spaces
entries.description: Find & Replace rule that turns every underscore into a space.

entries.name: Draft Suffix
entries.description: Adds a _draft suffix to every filename (before the extension).

entries.name: Three-Digit Numbering
entries.description: Appends a zero-padded running number after the name: photo_001, photo_002, ...

entries.name: Lowercase Names
entries.description: Converts the whole filename to lowercase.

entries.name: Remove Bracketed Text
entries.description: Regex rule that deletes anything in round brackets, including the brackets and any space before them.

entries.name: Dash After Four Characters
entries.description: Inserts a dash four characters into the name: IMG1234 becomes IMG1-234.

entries.name: Tidy Spaces
entries.description: Removes leading and trailing spaces and collapses runs of spaces into one.

entries.name: Remove Copy Markers
entries.description: Strips the clutter duplicated files accumulate: "Copy of ", " copy", " (1)", " (2)".

entries.name: Capture Artist and Title
entries.description: Set Variable rule for "Artist - Title" filenames: captures ARTIST and TITLE for later rules. Pairs with "Organise Into Artist Folders".

entries.name: Organise Into Artist Folders
entries.description: Set Name rule that rebuilds the name as ARTIST/TITLE, moving each file into a per-artist subfolder. Use below "Capture Artist and Title".

entries.name: Remove ' -' from the end (if present)
entries.description: Script rule that trims a dangling ' -' left at the end of a name after other rules have removed text.

entries.name: Collapse '- -' to '-'
entries.description: Tidies the double separator left behind when text between two dashes is removed.

entries.name: Normalise Episode Markers
entries.description: Rewrites TV episode markers like S01E02 or s01e02 into a consistent '- s01e02 -' form.

entries.name: Keep First Two Dash Segments
entries.description: Keeps only the first two ' - ' separated parts of a name — e.g. drops the episode title from 'Show - s01e02 - Title'.
